title: ZeRO: Memory Optimizations Toward Training Trillion Parameter Models
authors: S. Rajbhandari, J. Rasley, O. Ruwase, Y. He
before: Data-parallel training replicated optimizer state, gradients and weights on every GPU.
problem: That replication wastes most of the cluster's memory on identical copies.
breakthrough: Partition optimizer state, gradients and parameters across devices instead of duplicating them.
why: It removed the memory ceiling on data-parallel training and became the open-source default via DeepSpeed.
next: Used for MT-NLG, BLOOM and much of the open training ecosystem.
inherits: Sharded training state, now assumed in any large run.
